name: Oc hut
summary: Ốc hút is snails you suck from the shell, a Da Nang snack at Con Market and on the Phạm Hồng Thái night street.
origin: A Da Nang snack at the market and on the night street.
howToEat: Order it at Con Market, or on Phạm Hồng Thái after dark.
where: Con Market’s indoor counters and the snack row, with bánh tráng cuốn thịt heo, kem bơ, and chè.
Phạm Hồng Thái, after dark, from about 17:00 until after 23:00.
seoTitle: Oc hut — snails in Da Nang
seoDescription: Ốc hút is the snail snack at Con Market and on Phạm Hồng Thái at night.
